content:
maria: Quick update — Columbus (us-central-2) cutover preflight. Wanted to confirm routing policy ownership and KMS for resident data.

zack: I'm owner for routing policies. I'll handle the LB and route preferences. @devon you'll own DB replica provisioning?

devon: Yep, I'll spin up read replicas in columbus-1. ETA end of day Wed. Need subnet/CIDR from @maria.

maria: Subnet confirmed: 10.42.0.0/16 for app, 10.42.128.0/24 for db. Sharing infra plan in drive: https://go.redwood/columbus-plan (private)

sre-jen: Can we keep SR latency SLO for embeddings under 125ms? Need to confirm autoscaling min/gpu counts.

kai: For autoscale, suggested min 2 g4dn per pool, burst policy enabled. I'll post config snippet.

kai: ```yaml
autoscale:
  min_instances: 2
  max_instances: 12
  scale_policy: cpu_and_queue
```

product-elyse: Are there any privacy flags customers need to be aware of for residency? Legal asked about KMS separation.

maria: Yes — we'll use a dedicated CMEK key per customer in Columbus. @zack please ensure key-id is plumbed through routing metadata and audit logs are enabled.

zack: noted. Also need CR review for the route-policy change: PR #4823 — pinging @devon for infra change approval.

devon: Reviewing now. Two nits on the subnet templates. Will approve after I fix the CIDR reference (doing that now).

ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy for Columbus on 2033-05-22T02:30Z — 10% traffic for 30m. Link: https://deploys.redwood/columbus-canary

sre-jen: During canary, I'll run the smoke script: `scripts/smoke_columbus.sh` and monitor token-latency and error-rate. Will post results in this thread.

maria: Milestone check — what's left: DB replicas (devon), route-policy CR (zack+devon), CMEK wiring (zack), canary perf run (sre-jen), final docs and runbook (maria). Target cutover Fri 2033-05-24.

kai: FYI we need a fallback-region policy. Proposed order: us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1. I'll add that to the PR and include a small failover matrix.

product-elyse: OK from product side. We'll hold the customer notification until post-canary and after legal signs off on CMEK notes.

maria: @everyone please add blockers by EOD. If no blockers, I'll trigger the canary tomorrow per ops-bot schedule. :thumbsup:
